annotations.title: HTML Documentation to Clean Markdown Reader (Free)

description: Fetch and convert any public web documentation URL or HTML article into clean, stripped Markdown (<400 tokens) with a SHA-256 content hash. Use this when reading documentation, blog posts, or web pages while minimizing context-window noise (100 free calls/day/IP). Returns markdown body and provenance hash. Do NOT use for JSON REST APIs or schema-enforced x402 data endpoints needing LLM-refusal/5xx protection (use nullclear_fetch_guarded or nullclear_execute_escrow).

url.description: Public HTTPS webpage or documentation URL to extract into clean Markdown

name: nullclear_read_markdown
